summary: Memtly is an event-focused photo sharing platform and gallery system. It provides a live slideshow view and lets attendees access and upload pictures using a QR code.
goodFor: It suits individuals running private gatherings or public events who want a self-hosted alternative to commercial photo collection services.
watchOut: Development activity is slowing down, so you may encounter unresolved bugs or lack timely feature additions compared to more active projects.
deployNotes: Since it is packaged as a Docker container running on C#, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for uploaded media and place it behind a reverse proxy for TLS termination.
